//: Azure Static Web Apps configuration for bpad.prompt-forge.dev (ADR-0076).
The Content-Security-Policy below is the enforcing reader behind this
site's central claim. ADR-0076 says the site loads no analytics, no
trackers and no third-party scripts -- and trap 3 applies to a promise on
a web page exactly as it applies to a comment in Rust: nothing would fail
if somebody pasted a tag in. A CSP of 'self' means the browser refuses,
which turns the promise into a property.
Both sign-up forms post to /api/subscribe, which is same-origin: an Azure
Function in this Static Web App, matching af-site. That is what lets
connect-src stay at self with no exception, so the page makes no

globalHeaders.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'
